t: What Public Health Intervention Database Is All About
title: What Public Health Intervention Database Is All About
description: Public health interventions prevent disease at scale: clean water (Snow's pump handle, 1854), vaccines (smallpox eradicated), tobacco taxes (smoking fell from 42% to ~12% of US adults since 1965), and seatbelt laws. Effectiveness is measured in lives and DALYs per dollar; implementation conditions (trust, access, enforcement) decide real-world results. The best intervention is the one people actually use. This database is the complete health intervention: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Public Health Intervention Database: a complete reference database of full health intervention records.
